# telnyx_porting_order (Data Source)

An order to port phone numbers into Telnyx from another carrier.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies this porting order

### Read-Only

- `activation_settings` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--activation_settings))
- `additional_steps` (List of String) For specific porting orders, we may require additional steps to be taken before submitting the porting order.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `customer_group_reference` (String) A customer-specified group reference for customer bookkeeping purposes
- `customer_reference` (String) A customer-specified reference number for customer bookkeeping purposes
- `description` (String) A description of the porting order
- `documents` (Attributes) Can be specified directly or via the `requirement_group_id` parameter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--documents))
- `end_user` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--end_user))
- `messaging` (Attributes) Information about messaging porting process. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--messaging))
- `misc` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--misc))
- `old_service_provider_ocn` (String) Identifies the old service provider
- `parent_support_key` (String) A key to reference for the porting order group when contacting Telnyx customer support. This information is not available for porting orders in `draft` state
- `phone_number_configuration` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_number_configuration))
- `phone_number_type` (String) The type of the phone number
- `phone_numbers` (Set of String) List of phone numbers associated with this porting order
- `porting_phone_numbers_count` (Number) Count of phone numbers associated with this porting order
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `requirements` (Attributes List) List of documentation requirements for porting numbers. Can be set directly or via the `requirement_group_id` parameter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--requirements))
- `requirements_met` (Boolean) Is true when the required documentation is met
- `status` (Attributes) Porting order status (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))
- `support_key` (String) A key to reference this porting order when contacting Telnyx customer support. This information is not available in draft porting orders.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `user_feedback` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user_feedback))
- `user_id` (String) Identifies the user (or organization) who requested the porting order
- `webhook_url` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--activation_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `activation_settings`

Read-Only:

- `activation_status` (String) Activation status
- `fast_port_eligible` (Boolean) Indicates whether this porting order is eligible for FastPort
- `foc_datetime_actual` (String) ISO 8601 formatted Date/Time of the FOC date
- `foc_datetime_requested` (String) ISO 8601 formatted Date/Time requested for the FOC date


<a id="nestedatt--documents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `documents`

Read-Only:

- `invoice` (String) Returned ID of the submitted Invoice via the Documents endpoint
- `loa` (String) Returned ID of the submitted LOA via the Documents endpoint


<a id="nestedatt--end_user"></a>
### Nested Schema for `end_user`

Read-Only:

- `admin` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--end_user--admin))
- `location` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--end_user--location))

<a id="nestedatt--end_user--admin"></a>
### Nested Schema for `end_user.admin`

Read-Only:

- `account_number` (String) The authorized person's account number with the current service provider
- `auth_person_name` (String) Name of person authorizing the porting order
- `billing_phone_number` (String) Billing phone number associated with these phone numbers
- `business_identifier` (String) European business identification number. Applicable only in the European Union
- `entity_name` (String) Person Name or Company name requesting the port
- `pin_passcode` (String, Sensitive) PIN/passcode possibly required by the old service provider for extra verification
- `tax_identifier` (String) European tax identification number. Applicable only in the European Union


<a id="nestedatt--end_user--location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `end_user.location`

Read-Only:

- `administrative_area` (String) State, province, or similar of billing address
- `country_code` (String) ISO3166-1 alpha-2 country code of billing address
- `extended_address` (String) Second line of billing address
- `locality` (String) City or municipality of billing address
- `postal_code` (String) Postal Code of billing address
- `street_address` (String) First line of billing address



<a id="nestedatt--messaging"></a>
### Nested Schema for `messaging`

Read-Only:

- `enable_messaging` (Boolean) Indicates whether Telnyx will port messaging capabilities from the losing carrier. If false, any messaging capabilities will stay with their current provider.
- `messaging_capable` (Boolean) Indicates whether the porting order can also port messaging capabilities.
- `messaging_port_completed` (Boolean) Indicates whether the messaging porting has been completed.
- `messaging_port_status` (String) The current status of the messaging porting.


<a id="nestedatt--misc"></a>
### Nested Schema for `misc`

Read-Only:

- `new_billing_phone_number` (String) New billing phone number for the remaining numbers. Used in case the current billing phone number is being ported to Telnyx. This will be set on your account with your current service provider and should be one of the numbers remaining on that account.
- `remaining_numbers_action` (String) Remaining numbers can be either kept with their current service provider or disconnected. 'new_billing_telephone_number' is required when 'remaining_numbers_action' is 'keep'. One of `disconnect`, `keep`.
- `type` (String) A port can be either 'full' or 'partial'. When type is 'full' the other attributes should be omitted. One of `full`, `partial`.


<a id="nestedatt--phone_number_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phone_number_configuration`

Read-Only:

- `billing_group_id` (String) identifies the billing group to set on the numbers when ported
- `connection_id` (String) identifies the connection to set on the numbers when ported
- `emergency_address_id` (String) identifies the emergency address to set on the numbers when ported
- `messaging_profile_id` (String) identifies the messaging profile to set on the numbers when ported
- `tags` (Set of String)


<a id="nestedatt--requirements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `requirements`

Read-Only:

- `field_type` (String) Type of value expected on field_value field
- `field_value` (String) identifies the document that satisfies this requirement
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `requirement_type_id` (String) Identifies the requirement type that meets this requirement


<a id="nestedatt--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status`

Read-Only:

- `details` (Attributes List) A list of 0 or more details about this porting order's status (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status--details))
- `value` (String) The current status of the porting order

<a id="nestedatt--status--details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status.details`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) Identifier of an exception type
- `description` (String) Description of an exception type



<a id="nestedatt--user_feedback"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user_feedback`

Read-Only:

- `user_comment` (String) A comment related to the customer rating.
- `user_rating` (Number) Once an order is ported, cancellation is requested or the request is cancelled, the user may rate their experience
